principles.master_reference: Mueller Uigurica I print. Noto is technical foundation (tables, metrics anchors) only; geometric closeness to Noto is recorded as metadata and MUST NOT be used as an accept/reject gate.
principles.no_synthetic_ink: Connector detect->subtract->re-bridge pipelines are banned for production outlines. No reconnection, no bridging, no morphological repair that draws ink absent from the print.
principles.multi_attestation: Production outline = consensus of aligned attestations; majority vote at the 0.5 level is the only noise/connector/ink-spread removal mechanism.
principles.right_joining_special_case: ZAYIN (U+10F74) and FINAL HETH (U+10F75) join only on the right; their attestations must be word-final or isolated occurrences, never interior cuts, and they are exempt from any left-boundary heuristics.

rules: clusters with < production_min members produce DRAFT masters only, flagged draft=true in outline_report
attestations must come from >= 2 distinct words when cluster provenance allows
for right-joining letters, only pieces whose parent-word position is final or isolated count as attestations

consensus_parameters.alignment: centroid seed + 2 passes phase-correlation vs stack mean
consensus_parameters.hole_policy: fill if area < 0.3*stroke^2 OR consensus mean inside > 0.20; genuinely white counters kept regardless of size
consensus_parameters.contour: subpixel find_contours at 0.5 on 2x-upsampled Gaussian field, closed-curve smoothing window 7, micro-loops < 40 px^2 dropped
consensus_parameters.bezier: Schneider least-squares cubic fit, Newton-Raphson reparameterization, corner threshold 65 deg, tolerance 1.6 px

measurement_trust.reason: single crops carry the shared baseline connector (36-72 px band at 58-63% height); only multi-attestation consensus geometry is quotable

unicode_mapping_policy.basis: L2/20-191 identities only; Mueller never decides identity, proposal never decides shape
unicode_mapping_policy.ambiguous_masters: one shared master per confirmed_ambiguous cluster; all candidate glyphs recorded; resolution requires word-context reading, not geometry

phase_7_plan.name: Close coverage gaps via targeted attestation harvesting

steps.task: attestation inventory: audit every eligible cluster and every missing codepoint against attestation_requirements (tools/attestation_inventory.py)

targeted re-harvest: for missing letters (LAMEDH, NUN, SAMEKH, SHIN) and the marks/punctuation rejected as junk-for-letter-purposes, pull attestations directly from word clusters using validated masters as match templates - matching, not cutting; no reconnection
ambiguity resolution: use within-word neighbor context (which glyph forms can legally precede/follow per the joining model) to narrow confirmed_ambiguous groups; human confirms via a review sheet
regenerate masters for every cluster that gains attestations; enforce draft flags; emit updated outline_report.json

phase_7_plan.exit_criteria: every one of the 26 codepoints has either a production master (>=3 attestations), a shared ambiguous master with a documented resolution path, or a written justification that Mueller pp.36-45 does not attest it

phase_8_plan.name: Font integration (deferred)
constraints: only production masters merge into the UFO/TTF
baseline and joining-line placement from word-context statistics, not per-glyph bboxes
all OpenType tables preserved from Phase 1; GSUB/GPOS untouched until every referenced glyph has a master
